Question 1
?

The function v(t)=8et/2 gives the volume, in cubic centimeters, of methylated spirit produced by a chemical process t hours after the process begins. Find the instantaneous rate of change of spirit volume as a function of t.

a
4et/2 cubic centimeters per hour
b
8e2t cubic centimeters per hour
c
8et/2 cubic centimeters per hour
d
4e2t cubic centimeters per hour
e
16et/2 cubic centimeters per hour
